items.reason: The Delete action still requires a ruler rule, so passing only promRule removes it from Grafana list rows despite delete permission.
The Pause/Resume menu item remains gated on a Grafana ruler rule, which the Prometheus-only list rows no longer supply.
The silence drawer still requires a ruler alerting rule, so clicking Silence on Prometheus-only Grafana rows changes state without opening the drawer.
Delegation drops the federated-group check and uses isFederated=false, incorrectly enabling update/delete abilities for federated Mimir rules.
The skipped Grafana ability hook still grants Duplicate from global Grafana create permission, which the menu ORs into datasource-rule abilities even when their ruler ability denies duplication.
